dimensions.source: the 14 Inch, Q_walnut variant's technical-details rows, read in Chrome 2026-11-13: w from the W row; h taken as w, since the W x H row's 1.8" H is the depth (its Screen Size is 14 inches), kept in raw

notes: REJECTED 2026-11-13: Andrew went with colored frames, the Bernhard 18 in in Hunter Green and the AKCISOT 12 in in Blue Gray (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "be an interior designer: can we pick colored clocks? not just black/gold/brown? must fit and not look weird", then, of the green and the blue-gray: "ok buying now. record how HIGH I should put the clock. wrap up."). MOVED 2026-11-13 to the living room (Andrew, 2026-11-13, of the Anton at $57.99: "question clcok is nice, but 58 is kinda steep"): the living room's upper-left corner, on the window wall between the stair railing and the window, 48 in from the corner, 60 in to its center (F-70): 14 in reads from the sofa (14 ft), the chaise and the stairs, and its walnut matches the UGGLERUM, the WOHOMO and the Decofy; the dining room takes PresenTime's 11 in square in Golden (amazon-B0GSYWCRRZ), read from 5 ft. CANDIDATE 2026-11-13, the dining room's clock after the first picks were rejected (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "those clocks are too dark / hard to read. the first one is terrible and I get a headache trying to make out numbers."). Placement: the dining room's right wall, on the table's center line, 58 in to its center (F-70). Why: a white face with large plain black numerals and black hands, in a walnut-look frame for warmth beside the ash table and white marble (F-68 (10)), at 14 in for the 5 to 16 ft it is read from: the living room's clock is a different design, PresenTime's 16 in Anton square in Antique Hamilton Gold (amazon-B0BBG1TCCL), on Andrew's word (Andrew, 2026-11-13: "I don't want a plain black one though", then "I want 2 diferent clocks for living room / dining"; F-68 (2), F-70). Glass: its reviews are shared with the 18 in, and they report a glass cover that can be removed; take it out before it goes up (F-21). Read 2026-11-13: $32.99, 4.4 stars (108), Q_walnut, 14 Inch, 1.78 lb, plastic frame, white dial. The listing's walnut and natural frames come at 8 to 14 in; natural has pale wood hands, which read less well on white than walnut's black. rooms: the brief.
